newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Integrated Technology commences AMEX IPO.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Technology commences AMEX IPO.

text.p: Integrated Technology USA Inc (ITI) said on Thursday it had commenced an offering on the American Stock Exchange of three million shares of common stock and three million warrants at prices of $6 and $0.10, respectively.
Settlement will be on Monday, the company said.
National Securities Corp is underwriting the offering and has a 45-day option to purchase an additional 450,000 each of shares and warrants to cover overallotments.

Registered in the United States, ITI operates through two Israeli subsidiaries, both located in Jerusalem. The two companies design and market products for Internet telephony and computer/telephony integration.
The proceeds will go towards marketing, research, capital equipment and debt repayment, ITI said.
